def: A training-time attack that inserts or alters training data (data poisoning) or model parameters (model poisoning) to degrade a model, change its outputs on chosen inputs or plant a backdoor.
practice: For LLMs the routes are scraped pretraining data, fine-tuning and preference data and third-party weights; 2025 research found a small, roughly constant number of poisoned documents could plant a backdoor regardless of model size.
